figurative_meaning_en: To render non-existent or completely eliminate
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার শত্রুকে নস্যি আত করে দিয়েছে।
এই কোম্পানি বাজার থেকে নস্যি আত হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has completely eliminated his rival.
This company has been wiped out from the market.
history: Originates from the traditional practice of administering snuff (নস্যি) to induce sneezing, metaphorically extended to making something vanish instantly.
note: The input text 'নস্যাৎ করা' appears to be a variant or typographical form of the standard idiom 'নস্যি আত করা'.
